top_rule: Formalize what is invariant and what counts as evidence; do not formalize the empirical answer.

state_object.expression: W_t = (E_t, mu_t, Gamma_t, H_t ; P, C)

mu_t.role: finite population measure over extant cognitive organism/cell states

kernel_factorization.purpose: Independent removability for causal ablation. Social learning, inheritance, mutation, ecology and grouping must each be knockout-able without rewriting unrelated physics.
kernel_factorization.composition: Law(W_{t+1} | W_t) = composition of the eight kernels below; deterministic worlds are degenerate kernels.

declaration_schema_choice.reason: Per-kernel reads/writes is locally amendable when a kernel is added, and is the exact input the noninterference ancestor-closure needs. EB-F0-X may amend this choice.

K_senseact.role: legal sensing/action and their resource effects

kernel_factorization.declare_token_meaning: DECLARE is an obligation on the implementing run, not an open contract clause. A run whose kernel leaves DECLARE unresolved yields CANNOT_CHECK, never PASS.

noninterference_predicate.informal: protected assay state is not an ancestor of any birth/death/resource-transition decision
noninterference_predicate.formal: ancestors_of(D) INTERSECT ProtectedAssayNames == {} where D = {decision variables written by K_birthdeath} UNION {resource-transition decision variables written by K_world, K_senseact}

graph_construction.nodes: every state name appearing in any kernel's reads or writes, plus every kernel
graph_construction.edge_rule: for each kernel k: for every r in reads(k) add edge r -> k; for every w in writes(k) add edge k -> w
graph_construction.ancestors_of: reflexive-transitive closure of the reverse edge relation from the sink set D

noninterference_predicate.signature: check_noninterference(kernels: Mapping[str, KernelDecl], protected: Set[str], sinks: Set[str]) -> NIResult

exit_codes.0: PASS  — closure is disjoint from protected names
exit_codes.2: VIOLATION — at least one path exists; emit the witness path node-by-node
exit_codes.3: CANNOT_CHECK — a kernel omitted reads or writes, or a name is unresolvable against the declared state vocabulary

noninterference_predicate.cannot_check_is_not_pass: Mandatory. Exit 3 must never be folded into exit 0. Precedent: research/hsg-semantic-execution-v1/verify_freeze_chain.py exit-code contract; research/ocm-form-oracle-v1/oracle/objectives4.py partition_checkable.
noninterference_predicate.no_alarm_case_must_be_asserted: A selftest must show PASS on a clean declared factorization AND VIOLATION on a deliberately wired one, in the style of oracle/c_immutability.py selftest().
noninterference_predicate.consequence_of_violation: Invalidates any spontaneous/general-cognition claim for that run. Reportable result, not a warning.
noninterference_predicate.reuse_gap: No existing oracle module performs ancestor closure over a write graph. See PARENT_LEDGER.md gap G1.

endogenous_selection.rule: Birth/death/reproduction arise from P resource/accounting dynamics only.

w_i.name: realized reproductive contribution
w_i.explicitly_not: an intelligence reward or a selection input

ASSAY_SELECTED_CONTROL.purpose: positive control that leakage would be detectable

ecology_generator_support.registered_boundary: Search and evolution cannot discover adaptive responses to opportunities the world representation or generator cannot express or expose.
ecology_generator_support.obligation: Every open-endedness or evolvability claim must carry, as a stated assumption, the generator/VM support and the growth permissions in force.
